headline: SMR Noida Factory Hit by Ransomware, Production Ceased Amid Cybersecurity Crisis
body: The Noida branch of SMR Automotive Systems India has been heavily impacted by a recent ransomware attack, leading to a complete production shutdown. This incident highlights critical weaknesses in industrial cybersecurity protocols for significant automotive component suppliers.
